n231ae3d445.headline: Pollution alarm in China, in Beijing 24 times the limits
n231ae3d445.summary: Severe smog in Beijing, with pollution levels 24 times above limits, has caused flight disruptions. Coal still accounts for 60% of China's energy production.
n231ae3d445.why: China's heavy reliance on coal impacts energy markets and environmental policies, with pollution events affecting economic activity and regulatory responses.
